section.title: omega infix surface
section.text:
close: the bar's close price. close_ltf_touch: band proximity (upper / lower / none). MACD: MACD histogram — the 12/26 line minus its 9-period signal. MACD_ltf_cross: crossover event (Bullish / Bearish). zones: the ACTIVE structure-zone set (fair-value gaps and order blocks). zones_ltf_count: number of ACTIVE structure zones. ADX: 14-period average directional index (trend strength, 0–100). ADX_ltf_er: efficiency ratio over the last 3 points of a level series, |last − first| ÷ Σ|consecutive change| — 1 is a straight move, near 0 is chop. ADX_ltf_maxShare: largest share of the last 3 observations, max ÷ Σ — 1 is one bar carrying everything, 1/3 is perfectly even. ADX_ltf_rank_hi: ordinal across THIS REPORT’s coins, 1 = highest value, rendered as rank/report-size; computed per request, so it reflects the coins in this report and not the wider market. zones_ltf_support_dist: signed % from price to the nearest support zone midpoint. zones_ltf_resist_age_h: hours since the nearest resist zone was detected. ADX_ltf_RSI14_spread: % gap ADX_ltf vs RSI14. ADX_ltf_RSI14_spread_mean3: windowed mean. VWAP: volume-weighted average price accumulated since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor. dist_VWAP_htf: % from current price to VWAP_htf. dist_VWAP_htf_rank_hi: ordinal across THIS REPORT’s coins, 1 = highest value, rendered as rank/report-size; computed per request, so it reflects the coins in this report and not the wider market. EMA5: 5-period exponential moving average. EMA5_htf_EMA13_spread: % gap EMA5_htf vs EMA13. 3-period trajectory (t2 → … → now); EMA5_htf_EMA13_spread_trend = direction over the window.

outputs.meaning: close_touch: band proximity (upper / lower / none).
MACD_cross: crossover event (Bullish / Bearish).
zones_count: number of ACTIVE structure zones.
ADX_er: efficiency ratio over the last 3 points of a level series, |last − first| ÷ Σ|consecutive change| — 1 is a straight move, near 0 is chop.
ADX_maxShare: largest share of the last 3 observations, max ÷ Σ — 1 is one bar carrying everything, 1/3 is perfectly even.
ADX_rank_hi: ordinal across the tracked universe, 1 = highest value, rendered as rank/universe-size; the standing as of the last close, unchanged until the next one.
zones_support_dist: signed % from price to the nearest support zone midpoint.
zones_resist_age_h: hours since the nearest resist zone was detected.
ADX_RSI14_spread: % gap ADX vs RSI14. ADX_RSI14_spread_mean3: windowed mean.

dist_VWAP: % from current price to VWAP. dist_VWAP_rank_hi: ordinal across the tracked universe, 1 = highest value, rendered as rank/universe-size; the standing as of the last close, unchanged until the next one.
